what.text: This page follows asylum seekers from Kiribati in all host countries: people who have asked for international protection and are waiting for a decision.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 52 asylum seekers from Kiribati, and Australia hosted 90.4% of them.
After Australia, the largest hosts are the United States.

why.text: The fact pack records no armed conflict and no dated events for Kiribati, so it does not say why people left.
The main years of displacement in the data are 2022 to 2025.

when.text: UNHCR's series starts in 2005 at 5 asylum seekers.
The figure was at its highest, 53, at the end of 2024, and was almost the same at the end of 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took.
These are year-end totals summed over every host country that reported to UNHCR.
